capabilities: inject a search input above every base code block
filter base query results live as you type
append filters to existing WHERE clauses with AND logic
support embedded .base files as well as inline blocks
debounce input to limit update frequency
disambiguation: Despite the broad name, it only adds search-input filtering to base blocks, not other Bases features.
extras: Not yet in the Community Plugin store; install via BRAT or manual download from GitHub Releases. Documentation and troubleshooting live in an external docs site. Author requests sponsorship.
intentEvidence: Supercharge your Obsidian Bases workflow with dynamic search filtering — filter any base query instantly
problem: Obsidian Bases has no built-in way to interactively search or filter the results of a base query directly inside a note.
summary: Injects a live search input above base code blocks that dynamically adds a file.name filter to the base query as you type.
